verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a global HR/payroll SaaS like Rippling, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a data storage region or residency. The global payroll and location-based labor policy items concern where workers are located, not where data is stored, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
